# fresh-fvsbc

> Agent-facing index for fresh-fvsbc. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Running a case](usage.html): the command, its population file, its keyword set, and its exit codes.
- [Reference contracts](reference/index.html): what `fresh-fvsbc` requires, page by page.

## Reference

- [Tree-list input contract](reference/tree-list.html): the FVS-BC tree-record format, its fields, and its species codes.
- [Keyword-set contract](reference/keywords.html): the keyword vocabulary, the BC site and BEC input, and the tree-record format hazard.
- [Output contract](reference/outputs.html): the SQLite tables an FVS-BC run writes, and the rules for reading them.
- [Provenance contract](reference/provenance.html): what every run records, and where it lives.
- [nemora ingestion contract](reference/nemora-ingest.html): how a synthetic stem population becomes a tree list, and what cannot be supplied.
- [Calibration dataset](reference/calibration-data.html): the FAIB PSP ingest, its tables, inclusion rules, and data governance.
- [Calibration bundle](reference/calibration-bundle.html): the versioned parameter contract, its domain, bounds, pins, and provenance id.

## Agent protocols

- [Agent roles and models](agents/roles-and-models.html): this project's roles, the rule that separates the verifier from the implementer, and the log of the model chosen for each.

## API

- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
